selection_reasoning: The 'find carved_pumpkin' task is a straightforward observation/navigation task that requires the agent to locate a carved pumpkin placed in the Minecraft scene. It is easily verifiable (the agent must look at or approach the carved pumpkin), doesn't require deep Minecraft domain knowledge, and can be set up with a clear scene design. As a single atomic task, no dependency edges are needed.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the carved pumpkin (placed at spawn-relative [5, 1, -6] on a fence post with hay bales) AND face toward it, confirming visual identification. max_distance=5 ensures the player actually walked toward the pumpkin (~3+ blocks from spawn) rather than just spinning in place. facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at the pumpkin's carved face.

scene_description: A flat grassy clearing with a carved pumpkin scarecrow placed ~8 blocks from spawn. The pumpkin sits atop an oak fence post surrounded by hay bales, facing south toward the player's general direction. Additional scene elements (oak trees, cobblestone walls, stone brick platform with lantern) provide visual variety and slight occlusion to make finding the pumpkin a non-trivial exploration task.
task_text: Find the carved pumpkin in the scene. Look around and walk toward it.
design_notes: Carved pumpkin at ~5 ~1 ~-6 (facing south). Player spawns at origin facing north — must turn right ~40° to see pumpkin. Distance from spawn is ~7.87 blocks. Hay bales at ~4/~6 ~0 ~-6 and ~5 ~0 ~-7 provide visual scaffolding. Oak tree behind player provides partial occlusion. Cobblestone wall to the left serves as a distractor landmark.
